sloka: इति एवम् कपिराजेन संदिष्टो मारुतात्मजः ।चकार गमने बुद्धिम् यत्र तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥४-२-२८॥
transliteration: iti evam kapirājena saṁdiṣṭo mārutātmajaḥ ।cakāra gamane buddhim yatra tau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥4-2-28॥

translations.english: Instructed thus by the king of the monkeys, Hanuman, son of the Windgod, decided to meet both Rama and Lakshmana.
